ns2:RequirementInfo.ns2:RequirementDetails: Pre-Diabetes, Impaired Glucose Tolerance, Insulin Resistance of PCOS: Actualdiagnosis, results of fasting glucose, GTT, HbA1c, any cardiac risk factors, treatment, current weight, date of last visit;

(Antiphospholipid Syndrome) Bleeding/Clotting Disorder: actual diagnosis, dateof diagnosis, severity to include details of any history of bleeding or thrombotic events, details of all treatment, and history of any complications;
PFO surgery 2014/Congenital Heart Disease: type, symptoms/severity, results ofcardiac testing and current status;
3/2012 angina/ Cardiac: Actual diagnosis to include results of all cardiac testing, details of related treatment and current status;
Diabetes: Type, age of onset, current height/weight, treatment and results ofmost recent diagnostic testing to include HgbA1c;
(2005 Hodgkin's) Hodgkin's/Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma (diagnosis, results of testing, severity and current status);
Sleep Apnea: Date of diagnosis, type (obstructive vs central), results of diagnostic testing (pre and post to include number of AI/RDI), treatment and current status;
(08/2013 - Breast Cancer) Cancer/Tumor: Pathology and staging reports to include TNM, Clarks Level, Dukes etc., procedure reports, details of related treatment and current status;
Diabetes: Type, age of onset, current height/weight, treatment and results ofmost recent diagnostic testing to include HgbA1c;
(B)Hepatitis: Type, date of diagnosis, severity to include results of liver biopsy, if done and copy of most recent LFTs;
